\version "2.24.0"

\header {
  title = "Elegie"
  composer = "A. Musikus"
}

\score {
  \new PianoStaff <<
    \set PianoStaff.instrumentName = "Klavier"
    \new Staff = "upper" \with {
      midiInstrument = "acoustic grand"
    } \relative c' {
      \clef treble
      \key e \minor
      \time 3/4
      \tempo "Andante espressivo" 4 = 92

      % Phrase 1 (Takte 1-4)
      \p b'4( e''4. d''8 |
      c''2 b'4) |
      a'4( fis''4. e''8 |
      dis''2.) |

      % Phrase 2 (Takte 5-8)
      \mp g'4( b' d'' |
      e''4. d''8 c''4) |
      b'8(\< a' g' fis' a'4\! |
      g'2.) |

      % Phrase 3: Steigerung und Höhepunkt (Takte 9-12)
      \mf c''4( e''4. g''8 |
      b''8 a'' g'' fis'' e''4) |
      \f dis''8(\< e'' fis'' g'' a'' b''\! |
      c'''4\> b'' fis''\!) |

      % Phrase 4: Auflösung und Kadenz (Takte 13-16)
      \p e''4( b'4. g'8 |
      fis'8 g' e'4. dis'8 |
      \dim e'4 fis' dis' |
      <g b e'>2.\fermata\pp) \bar "|."
    }

    \new Staff = "lower" \with {
      midiInstrument = "acoustic grand"
    } \relative c {
      \clef bass
      \key e \minor
      \time 3/4

      % Takte 1-4
      e,8( b g' b, g' b,) |
      e,8( c' g' c, g' c,) |
      dis,8( b fis' b, fis' b,) |
      b,,8( fis b dis' fis'4) |

      % Takte 5-8
      g,8( d b d' b d) |
      c,8( e c' e' c' e) |
      d,8( a c' fis' c' a) |
      g,,8( d g b d'4) |

      % Takte 9-12
      c,8( g e' g c' g) |
      a,,8( e c' e a c') |
      b,,8( fis a dis' a fis) |
      b,,8( fis a b dis'4) |

      % Takte 13-16
      e,8( b g' b, g' b,) |
      a,,8( e c' e a c') |
      b,,8( fis a dis' fis'4) |
      <e,, b,, e,>2.\fermata \bar "|."
    }
  >>
  \layout {
    \context {
      \Score
      \override SpacingSpanner.base-shortest-duration = #(ly:make-moment 1/16)
    }
  }
  \midi {}
}
